verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Stripe has an API reference page (the meter-events entry), a public OpenAPI spec, a CLI, and isolated sandboxes. None of it documents an interactive API reference with runnable, in-browser examples. The sandboxes and OpenAPI spec are adjacent building blocks, not the interactive reference the story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
